def functions(path):
    result={}
    name=None
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith('\t.type\t') and line.endswith('@function'):
            name=line.split('\t')[2].split(',')[0]
            name=re.sub(r'17h[0-9a-f]{16}E','17hHASHE',name)
            result[name]=[]
        elif name and line.startswith('\t.size\t'):
            name=None
        elif name and re.match(r'\t[a-zA-Z]',line):
            line=re.sub(r'17h[0-9a-f]{16}E','17hHASHE',line)
            line=re.sub(r'\.LBB\d+_', '.LBB_',line)
            line=re.sub(r'\.LCPI\d+_', '.LCPI_',line)
            line=re.sub(r'\.Ltmp\d+', '.LtmpN',line)
            line=re.sub(r'\.Lanon\.[0-9a-f]+\.\d+', '.Lanon',line)
            result[name].append(line)
    return result
base=functions(root/f'baseline-{config}.s')
new=functions(candidate)
rows=[]
for name,body in base.items():
    if name not in new: continue

assert json.loads((p / 'final-comparisons-status.json').read_text()).get('finished_utc')
assert not (p / 'holdout-collection-layout.json').exists()
probe = p / 'holdout-collection-probe.rs'
meta = dict(plan=plan, probe_source=probe.read_text(), probe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), started_utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()), builds={}, runs=[])
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != 'LD_PRELOAD' and not k.startswith(('MIMALLOC_', 'MALLOC_'))}

def save():
    (p / 'holdout-collection-layout.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2) + '\n')

def normalize(text):
    result = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not re.match(r'^\s*[0-9a-f]+:\s', line):
            continue
        line = re.sub(r'^\s*[0-9a-f]+:\s*', '', line)
        line = re.sub(r'[-+]?0x[0-9a-f]+(?=\(%rip\))', 'RIP', line)
        line = re.sub(r'\b[0-9a-f]+(?=\s+<)', 'TARGET', line)
        line = re.sub(r'17h[0-9a-f]{16}E', '17hHASH', line)
        result.append(line)
    return result

for placement in plan['placements']:
    for label in ['baseline', 'final']:
        build = json.loads((p / f'{label}-page-batch-build-manifest.json').read_text())['builds']['secure']
        deps = Path(build['target_dir']) / 'release/deps'
        libraries = list(deps.glob('libmechanical_mimalloc-*.rlib'))
        assert len(libraries) == 1, libraries
        library = libraries[0]
        output = p / f'holdout-collection-{placement}-{label}'
        command = ['rustc', '--crate-name', 'borrowed_collection_probe', '--edition=2024', '-C', 'opt-level=3', '-C', 'lto=fat', '-C', 'codegen-units=1', '-C', 'panic=abort', '-L', f'dependency={deps}', '--extern', f'mechanical_mimalloc={library}', str(probe), '-o', str(output)]
        script = None
        if placement != 'default':
            offset = int(placement, 16)
            addresses = {name: int(value, 16) + (0 if name in ['caller_base', 'counters_base'] else offset) for name, value in plan['matched_addresses'].items()}
            script = '\n'.join(['SECTIONS {', f" .borrowed_fixture {hex(addresses['entry_base'])} : {{ *(.text.mi_bench_page_batch_fixture_run) }}", f" .borrowed_scanner {hex(addresses['scanner_base'])} : {{ *(.text._ZN19mechanical_mimalloc5types10page_batch24scan_detached_chain_impl*) }}", f" .borrowed_caller {hex(addresses['caller_base'])} : {{ *(.borrowed_collection_caller) }}", f" .borrowed_counters {hex(addresses['counters_base'])} : {{ *(.bss._ZN19mechanical_mimalloc9allocator17bench_diagnostics8COUNTERS*) *(.data._ZN19mechanical_mimalloc9allocator17bench_diagnostics8COUNTERS*) }}", '}', 'INSERT BEFORE .text;', ''])
            script_path = p / f'holdout-collection-{placement}.ld'
            script_path.write_text(script)
            command += ['-C', f'link-arg=-Wl,-T,{script_path}']
        subprocess.run(command, env=env, check=True)
        symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-S', '--defined-only', str(output)], text=True)
        counter = next(line for line in symbols.splitlines() if 'bench_diagnostics8COUNTERS' in line)
        if placement != 'default':
            assert int(counter.split()[0], 16) == addresses['counters_base'], counter
        rows = {}
        for name, needle in [('entry', 'mi_bench_page_batch_fixture_run'), ('scanner', 'page_batch24scan_detached_chain_impl'), ('caller', 'borrowed_collection_probe7measure')]:
            row = next(line for line in symbols.splitlines() if needle in line)
            if placement != 'default':
                assert int(row.split()[0], 16) == addresses[name + '_base'], row
            disassembly = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '--no-show-raw-insn', '--disassemble=' + row.split()[-1], str(output)], text=True)
            rows[name] = dict(symbol=row, disassembly=disassembly, normalized_instructions=normalize(disassembly))
        meta['builds'][f'{placement}-{label}'] = dict(argv=command, linker_script=script, executable=str(output), sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), library=str(library), library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), functions=rows, counters_symbol=counter)
        save()
        print('built', placement, label, flush=True)
meta['instruction_comparison'] = {}
for placement in plan['placements']:
    a, b = (meta['builds'][f'{placement}-{label}']['functions'] for label in ['baseline', 'final'])
    meta['instruction_comparison'][placement] = {name: a[name]['normalized_instructions'] == b[name]['normalized_instructions'] for name in a}
    assert meta['instruction_comparison'][placement]['entry']
    assert meta['instruction_comparison'][placement]['scanner']
meta['timing_started_utc'] = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())
save()
for round_index in range(plan['rounds']):
    placements = plan['placements'] if round_index % 2 == 0 else plan['placements'][::-1]
    for placement in placements:
        for case in plan['cases']:
            for label in (['baseline', 'final'] if round_index % 2 == 0 else ['final', 'baseline']):
                command = ['taskset', '-c', '0', meta['builds'][f'{placement}-{label}']['executable'], str(case['kind']), str(case['len']), str(case['destination']), str(plan['batch_rounds']), str(plan['live_fixtures'])]
                result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=300)
                meta['runs'].append(dict(round=round_index, placement=placement, case=case, label=label, argv=command, wall_ns=int(result.stdout.strip()), stderr=result.stderr))
        save()
    print('paired collection round', round_index + 1, 'finished', flush=True)
meta['results'] = []
for placement in plan['placements']:
    for case in plan['cases']:
        ratios = []
        for round_index in range(plan['rounds']):
            pair = {r['label']: r['wall_ns'] for r in meta['runs'] if r['placement'] == placement and r['case'] == case and r['round'] == round_index}
            ratios.append(pair['final'] / pair['baseline'])
        meta['results'].append(dict(placement=placement, case=case, ratios=ratios, median_ratio=statistics.median(ratios)))
meta['matched_case_ratios'] = [{**case, 'ratio': math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['median_ratio']) for r in meta['results'] if r['case'] == case and r['placement'] != 'default'))} for case in plan['cases']]
meta['geomeans'] = {placement: math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['median_ratio']) for r in meta['results'] if r['placement'] == placement)) for placement in plan['placements']}
meta['matched_geomean'] = math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['ratio']) for r in meta['matched_case_ratios']))
meta['finished_utc'] = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())
save()
print(json.dumps(dict(geomeans=meta['geomeans'], matched_geomean=meta['matched_geomean'], matched_case_ratios=meta['matched_case_ratios']), indent=2), flush=True)

arena_churn.behavior: Create heap, allocate and touch blocks, destroy heap, force collection; includes real OS page faults and purge work.

measurement-plan.json.comparison: Fresh paired baseline/candidate runs after the collection inlining change; alternate order by round. No timing has started for this candidate.

initial_experiment.findings: Original facade, collection, native secure, and allocation probe cases exceeded the unchanged budgets. Profiling and all four matched caller layouts isolated the default facade placement effect; collection disassembly exposed temporary borrowed-view stack materialization.
initial_experiment.source_change: Force inline PageCollection::collect_head; removes temporary view stores and restores a 40-byte entry frame in both modes. No production alignment padding.

measurement-plan.json.isolation: Complete builds and correctness checks first. Run suites sequentially with no competing agent-owned builds/tests. Screen harness build is an untimed setup phase.
measurement-plan.json.matched_caller_layout_control: Repeat every one of the four predeclared caller placements from the initial investigation; retain default-linked facade results. See holdout-layout-plan.json.

native_c_canaries.warmup: Discard first short run only, as defined in unchanged baseline screen implementation; retain every run in raw trace.

page_collection.baseline_adapter_adjustment: Documented one-flag-store parity patch in separate benchmark-only checkout; normal baseline allocator builds remain pristine.
page_collection.statistic: Median of raw sample time/iterations; paired ratio per round, then median ratio across rounds.

resources.affinity_correction: The original single-thread probe could migrate between CPUs 0 and 2; pin both comparison labels to CPU 0 in this experiment.
resources.unavailable: Allocator-internal counters remain null in the neutral C probe; report OS/process resources only.

scope_limits: Secure native canaries are the six bounded scenarios listed above; the full secure vendor suite is not covered.
Microbenchmarks and assembly cannot prove zero cost for every workload.
